newsitem.title: PERU: Dog walks free from Peruvian hostage siege.
newsitem.headline: Dog walks free from Peruvian hostage siege.

text.p: An alsatian called Emma was the only "hostage" to walk free on Thursday from the Japanese ambassador's residence where left-wing guerrillas are holding 74 captives
Looking dejected and emaciated after 16 days with no food, the sandy-coloured dog was enticed from the diplomatic compound by firemen who offered her Christmas cake.
But Emma's puppy was not with her.
Firemen believe the pup stepped on a mine planted by the rebels, causing the loud explosion heard last week in the garden of the mansion.
The dogs were thought to belong to Japanese Ambassador Morihisa Aoki, who was hosting a lavish cocktail party on December 17 when the guerrillas burst in.
"She was very weak and scared when we found her," said fire chief Otakar Lukac. "But she's picking up now and has started to bark."
